recipes.title: April Selection — April Hybrid Brewer
recipes.description: April Coffee Roasters' base recipe for their Hybrid Brewer: 14 g to 240 g in three ten-second pours, with the valve opened, closed, then opened again.

steps.instruction: open the valve; pour 40 g in a circle
close the valve; pour 100 g — 60 g in a circle and 40 g in the centre
open the valve; pour 100 g — 60 g in a circle and 40 g in the centre

recipes.notes: The Hybrid Brewer's valve is opened for the first pour, closed for the second and opened again for the third — the immersion window is what the closed valve buys. April state no water temperature for this recipe and give no finish time, only a ceiling: adjust the grind so the brew runs no longer than 3:00. Their filter recipes are dialled on a Mahlkönig EK43, though no setting is published for this one.
